title: aquilegia vulgaris var. typica
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris var. typica, commonly known as the common columbine, is a flowering plant species belonging to the buttercup family Ranunculaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia vulgaris var. typica include acting as an expectorant, diuretic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which helps in relieving coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
